profile.summary: East Bay Art Therapy is a private group practice based in Oakland, California. It offers art therapy, and also music and drama therapy, to children, teens, adults, families and groups in its offices and at partner sites. It also partners with schools, hospitals and other organizations around the Bay Area and offers workshops and professional training.
